interpretation: Descriptive learned label-intervention effects on fixed development inputs; not closed-loop success, untouched-test generalization, or calibrated/residualized leakage. Complete describes input coverage only.

metric_definitions.delta: clipped raw policy minus clipped decompensated policy, first action, continuous coordinates 0:6
metric_definitions.rmse: sqrt(mean squared error across 400 frames and six canonical continuous coordinates), per scene against stored same-state teacher
metric_definitions.rmse_difference: raw RMSE minus decompensated RMSE; positive means lower decompensated error against the specified teacher, not universal superiority
metric_definitions.sample_sd: Sample standard deviation of three equal-scene seed means, ddof=1; not a standard error or confidence interval

paired_label_experiment.c_true_source: unchanged c_true datasets from the bound defective demonstration files; calibration semantics inherited from source artifacts
paired_label_experiment.clipping_statistic_unit: training action-row/element exposures including repeated windows, not unique dataset frames
paired_label_experiment.comparison_scope: single defective Stack/Panda/D2L1 pool; label-only intervention, not yet the full cross-embodiment pooled study
paired_label_experiment.generic_runner_bypass_reason: generic standardized loss consumes batch.actions and would discard B8.action_target; local loop explicitly consumes the selected target
paired_label_experiment.label_transform: clip(original defective actions - stored same-state c_true,-1,1) via B8.action_target

original_label_reference_checkpoint.role: original-label scale source for all pairs; existing raw20261007 condition, not a pretrained initializer

paired_label_experiment.paired_rng_recipe: torch seed before identical model construction; independent seeded DataLoader shuffleTrue,batch16,num_workers0,iterator before loop,reset only at exhaustion
paired_label_experiment.scale_fit_labels: original defective actions only, both conditions
paired_label_experiment.target_binding: same episode and current/future action-slot indices for actions and c_true; no clean-twin observations substituted

statistical_units: Three paired training-seed replications evaluated on the same six development-heldout scenes; 18 cells are dependent and frames are not independent replicates.
undefined_policy: Any undefined scene makes that seed mean and overall mean/dispersion undefined; no denominator changes. CSV encodes undefined as an empty field.
weighting: equal six-scene means within training seed, then equal three-seed means
